source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.3 says the hardware result was a simple rewrite in an already highly optimized Verilog implementation of a key TPU arithmetic circuit in the matrix multiplication unit; the rewrite removed unnecessary bits while reducing power and area.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can validate hardware_rewrite_provenance metadata and can link it to the hardware RTL/EDA evidence boundary. It does not claim an exact TPU arithmetic-circuit identity, matrix-multiplication-unit context, real source or modified Verilog files, rewrite diff or AST artifact, changed-span artifacts, removed-bit or signal inventory, semantic rewrite category evidence, rewrite rationale evidence, source/modified/diff hashes backed by artifacts, per-removed-bit PPA linkage, per-removed-bit verification linkage, PPA delta artifacts, functional verification outputs, component review or owner signoff, or complete artifact refs.
